summary:
**Space Game Explorer** is a browser game that helps young learners discover astronomy through play. Players pilot a rocket past the Sun, planets, moons, and a comet. Each discovery reveals an accurate fact followed by a quick quiz, and correct answers earn fuel.

Controls are simple: arrow keys or A and D to turn, Up, W, or Space to thrust. On phones and tablets, on-screen buttons do the same. Fuel is limited, so players collect glowing stars to refuel.

A mini-map, a Discovery Log, a pause button, and a "How to Play" tutorial help players track their progress. Three difficulty levels and thirteen discoverable objects keep exploration engaging. The game runs in any modern browser with no installation, making it well suited to classrooms and home learning.
details:
SPACE-GAME-EXPLORER is an educational space exploration game designed to make learning about planets and space more interesting and interactive.

In this game, players control a spaceship and travel from Earth to different planets, including the Moon, Mars, and Saturn. Players can explore space, collect stars, avoid asteroids, and complete different levels.

The main aim of this project is to create awareness about space exploration and make students interested in astronomy through an enjoyable gaming experience.

This project was developed using GDevelop with game elements such as spaceship movement, planet environments, space backgrounds, obstacles, and interactive levels.

This game combines education and entertainment to encourage curiosity about the universe and space science.
